purpose: Phase 3 closure: typed per-case admission of the development pilot into evidence-object construction, the label-evidence layers, the driver tags, the claim policy and the map of superseded flags. Read by ehr_evidence_app.gnn.admission, which refuses to run unless these values equal the ones it implements.
prediction_definition: argmax of the inherited bridge's single-graph diagnosis logits (one graph per forward pass)
held_out_definition: outside the upstream training partition only; the label vocabulary and the feature normalisation statistics were computed over all patients

label_layers.A: rule: output position i, training target i and label_vocab[i] share one axis in the pinned graph builder, trainer, model and bridge
label_layers.B: decode: concept_id equals label_vocab[label_index] in the published output record
label_layers.C: run binding: the checkpoint's saved pos_weight reproduces exactly from the current labels in the current label order under the replayed split, and a reversed label order does not

driver_tags.attachment_rule: visits whose visit-to-concept edges reach the driver's concept node in the raw (unpreprocessed) patient graph; the target is the final visit
driver_tags.target_outcome_rule: a condition driver attached only to the target visit is a target-visit diagnosis and is excluded
driver_tags.narration_rule: positive score, a patient node, and not a target-visit diagnosis

supersedes.current: upstream partition known; held out defined by held_out_definition
absent; restricts event-level claims and does not block cases
